title: [review] adaptation_vectors.rs: hex_decode panics on odd-length input
description: The hex_decode function slices s[i..i+2] without checking that s.len() is even. If a test vector contains an odd-length hex string (e.g., a typo like "abc" instead of "ab"), the final iteration will panic with index out of bounds rather than returning a clear error. Add a guard: if s.len() % 2 != 0 { panic!("odd-length hex string") } or return Result.
